41class MessageBitInput
42{
43public:
44 MessageBitInput(const char* aBuffer)
45 : mBuffer(aBuffer)
46 , mBitOffset(0)
47 {
48 }
49
50 void Read(unsigned& aValue, int aBitCount)
51 {
52 Unpack(mBuffer, aValue, mBitOffset, mBitOffset + aBitCount - 1);
53 mBitOffset += aBitCount;
54 }
55 void Read(unsigned short& aValue, int aBitCount)
56 {
57 unsigned int readValue;
58 Unpack(mBuffer, readValue, mBitOffset, mBitOffset + aBitCount - 1);
59 aValue = readValue;
60 mBitOffset += aBitCount;
61 }
62 void Read(unsigned char& aValue, int aBitCount)
63 {
64 unsigned int readValue;
65 Unpack(mBuffer, readValue, mBitOffset, mBitOffset + aBitCount - 1);
66 aValue = readValue;
67 mBitOffset += aBitCount;
68 }
69 void Skip(int aBitCount) { mBitOffset += aBitCount; }
70 int GetBitOffset() { return mBitOffset; }
71
72private:
73 const char* mBuffer;
74 int mBitOffset;
75};
76
77class MessageBitOutput
78{
79public:
80 MessageBitOutput(char* aBuffer)
81 : mBuffer(aBuffer)
82 , mBitOffset(0)
83 {
84 }
85
86 void Write(unsigned aValue, int aBitCount)
87 {
88 Pack(mBuffer, aValue, mBitOffset, mBitOffset + aBitCount - 1);
89 mBitOffset += aBitCount;
90 }
91 void Skip(int aBitCount) { mBitOffset += aBitCount; }
92 int GetBitOffset() { return mBitOffset; }
93 void Reset() { mBitOffset = 0; }
94
95private:
96 char* mBuffer;
97 int mBitOffset;
98};

148#define DEFINE_ACCESSORS(_CLASS_, _TYPE_) \
149 typedef _TYPE_ accessor_type; \
150 _CLASS_& operator=(_TYPE_ aValue) \
151 { \
152 mValue = (value_type)aValue; \
153 return *this; \
154 } \
155 operator _TYPE_() const { return (_TYPE_)mValue; }

204template<unsigned BIT_COUNT>
205class FieldBase
206{
207private:
209 static const int HighBit = 1 << (BIT_COUNT - 1);
210 static const int LowMask = HighBit - 1;
211 static const int LowestValue = -(LowMask + 1);
212 static const int HighestValue = LowMask;
213
214public:
215 FieldBase()
216 : mValue(0)
217 {
218 }
219 typedef NoAccessorTypeTag accessor_type;
220 typedef NoAccessorUnitsTag accessor_units;
221 typedef FieldNoStatementInvalidTag no_statement_type;
222 typedef NoEnumStringMapTag enum_map_type;
223
224 static const unsigned int cFIELD_SIZE = BIT_COUNT;
225 static const unsigned int cMID_VALUE = (1u << cFIELD_SIZE) / 2;
226 static const unsigned int cMAX_VALUE = (1u << cFIELD_SIZE) - 1;
227
229 typedef typename SmallIntType<BIT_COUNT>::integer_type value_type;
230
231 friend MessageBitOutput& operator<<(MessageBitOutput& aAr, FieldBase<cFIELD_SIZE>& aField)
232 {
233 aAr.Write(aField.mValue, cFIELD_SIZE);
234 return aAr;
235 }
236
237 friend MessageBitInput& operator<<(MessageBitInput& aAr, FieldBase<cFIELD_SIZE>& aField)
238 {
239 aAr.Read(aField.mValue, cFIELD_SIZE);
240 return aAr;
241 }
242
243 value_type GetRawData() const { return mValue; }
244
245 template<class T>
246 value_type SafeCast(T aValue) const
247 {
248 return ut::safe_cast<value_type, T>(aValue);
249 }
250
251 void SetRawData(value_type aValue) { mValue = aValue; }
252
253protected:
256 int DecodeTC(unsigned a2C) const
257 {
258 int r = a2C;
259 if (a2C & HighBit)
260 {
261 unsigned int allBits = (unsigned int)-1;
262 r = (int)((allBits << BIT_COUNT) | a2C);
263 }
264 return r;
265 }
266
267 unsigned EncodeTC(int aInt) const
268 {
269 if (aInt < LowestValue)
270 {
271 aInt = LowestValue;
272 }
273 if (aInt > HighestValue)
274 {
275 aInt = HighestValue;
276 }
277 return static_cast<unsigned int>(aInt);
278 }
279
281 unsigned EncodeTCMod(int aInt) const
282 {
283 if (aInt < LowestValue)
284 {
285 aInt = LowestValue;
286 }
287 if (aInt > HighestValue - 1)
288 {
289 aInt = HighestValue - 1;
290 }
291 return static_cast<unsigned int>(aInt);
292 }
293 value_type mValue;
294};

357template<unsigned BIT_COUNT, typename NoStatementTag>
358class NormalField : public FieldBase<BIT_COUNT>
359{
360 typedef typename Detail::NS_Valuator<BIT_COUNT, NoStatementTag> NS_ValuatorType;
361
362public:
363 typedef FieldNoStatementValidTag no_statement_type;
364 static const unsigned int cNO_STATEMENT_VALUE = NS_ValuatorType::value;
365 NormalField() { SetNoStatement(); }
366 void SetNoStatement() { FieldBase<BIT_COUNT>::mValue = (unsigned char)cNO_STATEMENT_VALUE; }
367 bool IsNoStatement() const { return FieldBase<BIT_COUNT>::mValue == cNO_STATEMENT_VALUE; }
368};

619template<unsigned BIT_COUNT>
620struct AltitudeFieldConverter;
621template<>
622struct AltitudeFieldConverter<18>
623{
624 typedef FieldBase<18>::value_type value_type;
625 static value_type Convert(double aAlt)
626 {
627 if (aAlt < -2000)
628 {
629 return (value_type)0;
630 }
631 else if (aAlt <= -0.5)
632 {
633 return (value_type)(-2000 / aAlt);
634 }
635 else if (aAlt <= 129070.5)
636 {
637 return (value_type)((int)(aAlt / 0.5) + 4001);
638 }
639 else
640 {
641 return (value_type)(262143);
642 }
643 }
644 static double Convert(value_type aVal)
645 {
646 if (aVal <= 0)
647 {
648 return -99999.9;
649 }
650 else if (aVal < 4001)
651 {
652 return -2000.0 / aVal;
653 }
654 else if (aVal < 262143)
655 {
656 return 0.5 * (aVal - 4001);
657 }
658 else
659 {
660 return 999999.9;
661 }
662 }
663};
664
665template<>
666struct AltitudeFieldConverter<13>
667{
668 typedef FieldBase<13>::value_type value_type;
669 static value_type Convert(double aAlt)
670 {
671 int intAlt = (int)(aAlt / 25.0);
672 if (intAlt == 63)
673 {
674 ++intAlt;
675 }
676 if (intAlt == 64)
677 {
678 --intAlt;
679 }
680 if (intAlt > (int)FieldBase<13>::cMAX_VALUE)
681 {
682 intAlt = (int)FieldBase<13>::cMAX_VALUE;
683 }
684 return (value_type)intAlt;
685 }
686 static double Convert(value_type aVal)
687 {
688 if (aVal == 63 || aVal == 64)
689 {
690 return -1.0;
691 }
692 return aVal * 25.0;
693 }
694};
695
696template<>
697struct AltitudeFieldConverter<12>
698{
699 typedef FieldBase<12>::value_type value_type;
700 static value_type Convert(double aAlt)
701 {
702 if (aAlt < -2000)
703 {
704 return (value_type)0;
705 }
706 else if (aAlt <= -25)
707 {
708 return (value_type)(-2000 / aAlt);
709 }
710 else if (aAlt <= 100325)
711 {
712 return (value_type)((int)(aAlt / 25) + 81);
713 }
714 else
715 {
716 return (value_type)(4095);
717 }
718 }
719 static double Convert(value_type aVal)
720 {
721 if (aVal <= 0)
722 {
723 return -99999.9;
724 }
725 else if (aVal < 81)
726 {
727 return -2000.0 / aVal;
728 }
729 else if (aVal < 4095)
730 {
731 return 25 * (aVal - 81);
732 }
733 else
734 {
735 return 999999.9;
736 }
737 }
738};

746};

749template<unsigned FIELD_SIZE>
750class AltitudeField : public NormalField<FIELD_SIZE, NoStatementMax>
751{
752 typedef typename NormalField<FIELD_SIZE, NoStatementMax>::value_type value_type;
753
754public:
755 typedef double accessor_type;
756 typedef AccessorUnitsMetersTag accessor_units;
757 AltitudeField& operator=(double aVal)
758 {
759 SetAltitudeMeters(aVal);
760 return *this;
761 }
762 operator double() const { return GetAltitudeMeters(); }
763 void SetSkyObscured()
764 {
765 if (FIELD_SIZE == 13)
766 {
767 this->mValue = 63;
768 }
769 }
770 bool IsSkyObscured() const
771 {
772 if (FIELD_SIZE == 13)
773 {
774 return this->mValue == 63;
775 }
776 return false;
777 }
778 void SetUnknown() { this->mValue = this->cMAX_VALUE; }
779 bool IsUnknown() const { return this->mValue == this->cMAX_VALUE; }
780 void SetAltitudeFeet(double aAlt) { this->mValue = Detail::AltitudeFieldConverter<FIELD_SIZE>::Convert(aAlt); }
781 void SetAltitudeMeters(double aAlt) { SetAltitudeFeet(MetersToFeet(aAlt)); }
782 double GetAltitudeFeet() const
783 {
784 if (IsUnknown())
785 {
786 return -1.0;
787 }
788 return Detail::AltitudeFieldConverter<FIELD_SIZE>::Convert(this->mValue);
789 }
790 double GetAltitudeMeters() const { return FeetToMeters(GetAltitudeFeet()); }
791};

883class EllipseOrientationOrTiltField : public NormalField<11, NoStatementValue<1024>>

885 // const XATypes::Float64Min UNCERTAINTY_ORIENTATION_LSB = 0.08789;

921 {
922 return 0;

999// four character callsign, 6 bits per character
1000// 0 = ' '
1001// 1-9 = '1'-'9'
1002// 10-36 = 'A'-'Z'
1003// 63 = '0'
1004//(others are invalid)
1005class WSF_L16_EXPORT CallsignFieldBase
1006{
1007protected:
1008 char GetCallsignChar(int aSixBit) const;
1009 int GetCharEnumeration(char aCharacter) const;
1010};
1011
1012template<unsigned CHAR_COUNT>
1013class CallsignField : public FieldBase<CHAR_COUNT * 6>, public CallsignFieldBase
1014{
1015public:
1016 static const int cCHARACTER_COUNT = CHAR_COUNT;
1017
1018 bool IsInvalidValue() const
1019 {
1020 int callsign = this->mValue;
1021 int bitShift = 18;
1022 for (int i = 0; i < cCHARACTER_COUNT; bitShift -= 6, ++i)
1023 {
1024 if ('_' == GetCallsignChar((callsign >> bitShift) & 0x3f))
1025 {
1026 return false;
1027 }
1028 }
1029 return true;
1030 }
1031
1032 typedef std::string accessor_type;
1033
1034 operator std::string() const
1035 {
1036 std::string lReturn;
1037 int callsign = this->mValue;
1038 int bitShift = 18;
1039 for (int i = 0; i < 4; bitShift -= 6, ++i)
1040 {
1041 lReturn += GetCallsignChar((callsign >> bitShift) & 0x3f);
1042 }
1043 return lReturn;
1044 }
1045
1046 void operator=(const std::string aCallsign)
1047 {
1048 int callsign = 0;
1049 int bitShift = 18;
1050 for (int i = 0; i < cCHARACTER_COUNT; bitShift -= 6, ++i)
1051 {
1052 if (aCallsign.length() <= unsigned(i))
1053 {
1054 continue;
1055 }
1056 int num = GetCharEnumeration(aCallsign[i]);
1057 callsign += num << bitShift;
1058 }
1059 this->mValue = callsign;
1060 }
1061};

1553template<unsigned BIT_COUNT>
1554class LatitudeField : public NormalField<BIT_COUNT, NoStatementMid>
1555{
1556public:
1557 typedef double accessor_type;
1558 typedef AccessorUnitsLatitudeTag accessor_units;
1559 LatitudeField& operator=(double aLatitude)
1560 {
1561 int maxInt = this->cMAX_VALUE;
1562 int numBitsMinusOne = this->cFIELD_SIZE - 1;
1563 int mymidInt = (1 << numBitsMinusOne);
1564 int mymidIntMinusOne = mymidInt - 1;
1565 if (aLatitude > 0.0f)
1566 {
1567 this->mValue = (int)(aLatitude / 90.0 * mymidIntMinusOne);
1568 }
1569 else if (aLatitude < 0.0f)
1570 {
1571 this->mValue = maxInt + (int)(aLatitude / 90.0 * mymidIntMinusOne);
1572 }
1573 else
1574 {
1575 this->mValue = 0;
1576 }
1577 return *this;
1578 }
1579
1580 operator double() const
1581 {
1582 double rlat;
1583 int midIntMinusOne = this->cMID_VALUE - 1;
1584 if (this->mValue < this->cMID_VALUE)
1585 {
1586 rlat = 90.0 * ((double)this->mValue) / midIntMinusOne;
1587 return rlat;
1588 }
1589 else if (this->mValue > this->cMID_VALUE)
1590 {
1591 rlat = -90.0 * ((double)(this->cMAX_VALUE - this->mValue)) / midIntMinusOne;
1592 return rlat;
1593 }
1594 return 90.0;

1663template<unsigned BIT_COUNT>
1664class LongitudeField : public NormalField<BIT_COUNT, NoStatementMid>
1665{
1666public:
1667 typedef double accessor_type;
1668 typedef AccessorUnitsLongitudeTag accessor_units;
1669 LongitudeField& operator=(double aLongitude)
1670 {
1671 int maxInt = this->cMAX_VALUE;
1672 int numBitsMinusOne = this->cFIELD_SIZE - 1;
1673 int mymidInt = (1 << numBitsMinusOne);
1674 int mymidIntMinusOne = mymidInt - 1;
1675 if (aLongitude >= 0.0f)
1676 {
1677 this->mValue = (int)(aLongitude / 180.0 * mymidIntMinusOne);
1678 }
1679 else if (aLongitude < 0.0f)
1680 {
1681 this->mValue = maxInt + (int)(aLongitude / 180.0 * mymidIntMinusOne);
1682 }
1683 return *this;
1684 }
1685
1686 operator double() const
1687 {
1688 int range = this->cMID_VALUE - 1;
1689 if (this->mValue < this->cMID_VALUE)
1690 {
1691 return (double)this->mValue / range * 180.0;
1692 }
1693 else if (this->mValue > this->cMID_VALUE)
1694 {
1695 return -(double)(this->cMAX_VALUE - this->mValue) / range * 180.0;
1696 }
1697 return 0.0;
1698 }
1699};
